sentiment.rationale: The company reported a modest beat on EPS and revenue growth, but forward guidance for Q2 2025 was essentially in line with prior trends, with FX-neutral growth of 1-2% for both revenue and GMV. Management expressed confidence in the business momentum, but the guidance was not raised materially, and the company noted a dynamic demand environment. The score reflects genuine operational momentum (fourth consecutive quarter of positive GMV growth) but no formal guidance raise, so it sits at the lower end of the positive range.

summary.eps: GAAP EPS of $1.06, Non-GAAP EPS of $1.38, up 25% and 10% respectively year-over-year
summary.guidance: Q2 2025: Revenue $2.59-$2.66 billion, FX-Neutral Y/Y growth 1%-2%; GMV $18.6-$19.1 billion, FX-Neutral Y/Y growth 1%-2%; Diluted GAAP EPS $0.87-$0.94; Diluted Non-GAAP EPS $1.24-$1.31
